messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed the best-score behavior:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60) now replaces a saved best only when the new move count is lower. Equal or worse results keep the existing record.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) now shows `none` when the current size has no recorded best.

This follows requirement R10. I did not run tests.
